note: v56.99 — Shared GPT-6 Luna with one monthly $10 budget; explicit personal provider ownership, current contracts, native transport, queued translation and honest readiness (P1410–P1413). Production provisioning and deployment remain operator-owned.

p.title: Initialize shared AI readiness independently of translation activity
p.symptom: The local sidebar could keep showing a connection check even though migration was held, when cached news required no AI translation and no chat had been sent.
p.root_cause: The passive quota badge read the default route before public configuration and health were initialized; checking depended on a later consumer request.
p.fix: Initialize the shared route once at UI boot with a health-only check, then update its badge. Disabled public configuration explicitly shows that the shared connection is being prepared and advertises no capacity.
p.violated_rule: P1070/R592 separate route readiness from user switch and quota; P1410 do not certify old deployed provider readiness.
p.prevention: ci-extension-api-runtime-check verifies the held-route label and unavailable capacity; the local settings screen and offline published-route browser fixture provide separate UI evidence.
p.verification: No generation request or key is needed for boot readiness. Held configuration and published Responses transport are verified separately from actual deployed migration.

qa.text: P1413: held public AI configuration shows a preparation status and no usable capacity; boot checks readiness independently of translation.

changelog: **공용 AI 상태 초기화 (P1413):** 번역·채팅 요청 전에도 연결 상태를 확인하고 전환 보류 상태를 준비 중으로 표시.
